title: Separate SCHC packet-size limit from reconstructed IPv6 size in Rust
description: The refreshed mqtt_sn_profile_size_exact_maximum vector encodes a valid 22,554-byte SCHC packet that reconstructs to 22,581 IPv6 bytes. Rust codec applies SCHC_FRAG_MAX_PACKET_SIZE/SCHC_MAX_DECOMPRESSED to reconstructed Rule 7 output and rejects it. Align encoded SCHC admission with MAX_PACKET_SIZE=22,554 while bounding reconstructed output by the exact maximum expansion and caller buffer; add boundary tests.
notes:
Fixed Rust SCHC profile-size enforcement on encoded length, not reconstructed IPv6 length. Rule255 and Rule7 exact 22554-byte encoded boundary accepted, +1 rejected; shared vectors and full suite pass.
Rust codec now enforces the separation across all unfragmented decompress paths: ingress/compressor admission stays on encoded length (SCHC_FRAG_MAX_PACKET_SIZE=22554, Rule ID included); rules 0-7 reconstruction is bounded only by the caller buffer (Rule 7 22554->22581, Rule 0 22554->22583, Rule 2 22554->22579 exact-max all accepted). Removed SCHC_MAX_DECOMPRESSED scratch caps in decompress_coap/icmpv6_echo/rpl_dio/rpl_dao via direct caller-buffer assembly + piecewise checksums; split has_oscore_option parser preserves no-mutation-on-error. Two tests pinning the old 1500 reconstruction cap updated to the corrected caller-capacity contract. New boundary regressions for rules 0/2/7/255. No API changes; lichen-link and lichen-node compile. Pre-existing baseline: link_layer_integration fails to compile without --all-features due to lichen-link feature gating (also fails on stashed baseline); passes with --all-features. Authenticated-path 1500 scratch caps filed as follow-up bead project-LICHEN-worker6-buh8.
close_reason: Wave 2: verified fixed at HEAD / completed missing boundary+decode regressions; suites green (schc 1366, link 836, lichen-link 18 targets, lichen-schc 164, vector-security 26).
